verdict.summary: Round 6 resolves the prior authorization-widening finding. validate_policy_for_n3 now rejects every permission or prohibition rule having more than one distinct odrl:action, odrl:target, or odrl:assignee before any N3 stratum runs. The public-path regressions exercise multi-valued assignee, target, and action permissions plus a multi-assignee prohibition, assert refusal, and verify that the graph remains unchanged; the assignee test also demonstrates that the Rust reference selects only one of the two values, so the test is not vacuous. A single-valued control confirms the validator does not simply reject all policies. The implementation is fail-closed and consistent with the documented never-more-permissive property.
